owner_scope: Autonomous implementation with logged decisions and agent coordination; Civo central/Akamai worker per latest owner topology

questions.question: How to retain a manager Ref across separate SSH calls?
questions.decision: One root socket-activated broker process and one UnitReferences+WorkerRPC; singleton kernel lock, no one-request keeper.

questions.question: Does completed release node capacity?
questions.decision: No. Canonical custody must first be verified and fsynced. Then authenticated retire; release capacity only on exact retained acknowledgement.

questions.question: Can lost reply retry retire?
questions.decision: No automatic retry. Read action retirement verifies durable receipt/storage, or reports uncertainty without creation or cleanup.

questions.question: What if storage/fsync or reference session becomes uncertain?
questions.decision: Quarantine preserves existing process/connection where possible, only bounded reads, no new mutations/keeper/replay. Operator reconciliation for incomplete state.

questions.question: Can a new process adopt previous active work?
questions.decision: No rearm. Startup validates all receipts/bindings/retained proofs on current boot/epoch; old live/uncertain/unretired work blocks listener pending exact reconciliation.

questions.question: How to avoid conflict with Apoio consumer/perfil work?
questions.decision: 691 covers broker packet only. Apoio692 owns profile/CatalogV2/consumer/pairedguard in distinct source; current source is contract only until reviewed.
